unit.why: A short anecdote: a man complains of a demon (lets) in his wine cellar, and the tzaddik diagnoses that the cause is his maidservant's sins and orders her expelled, which works.

stories.start_quote: פ"א בא לפניו איש אחד מרחוק
stories.summary_en: A man from afar complains to the tzaddik of a mocking evil spirit heard in his wine cellar; the tzaddik tells him to expel his maidservant, whose sins created the spirit, citing a Masorah wordplay (גרש האמה / גרש לץ), and so it happened.

tags.why: the tzaddik rids the house of the spirit
the story centres on protection from a demon
